title: Dropshipping Quietly Died - Here's What Replaced It In 2026
summary: E-commerce veteran: tariffs, lost shipping subsidies, factory-direct marketplaces, and delivery expectations killed arbitrage dropshipping; survivors use it to test then build brands.

assertions.quote: that version was always a house of cards built on a trade policy loophole and low shipping costs that no longer exist

verdicts.note: De minimis was suspended in 2025 and subsidized postal rates ended; landed costs rose sharply.

assertions.quote: you can't compete on price with companies that own the supply chain
The customers waiting two and a half weeks for an overseas package are not happy. They open disputes, leave bad reviews
90% of drop shipping stores fail within the first year
the actual numbers on drop shipping outcomes are not what the content landscape suggests

verdicts.note: Modelling result: because talent is judged a posteriori from reached success, the evaluation switches cause and effect and rates the luckiest as the most talented, which is the survivorship mechanism, though the paper does not address advice or speed of enrichment.

assertions.quote: Drop shipping has always been a testing tool, even when most people were treating it like a full business model.
hoping the ad works before the charge backs and the returns eat what's left of the margin
The sellers drop shipping from a US warehouse are seeing 3 to 5-day delivery times, and the customer satisfaction is just way better.

verdicts.note: Domestic fulfillment delivers in days; the trade-off is higher unit cost.

assertions.quote: rebuilt the entire store around that single product with US-based inventory and real branding
His margins went from around 15% to over 40% in the same year, and his return rate dropped by more than half

verdicts.note: Brand owners do report higher margins; the example is one seller's anecdote.
